# Countdown

<p class="gls-text-lead">Create a simple countdown timer.</p>

## Usage

To apply this component, add the `gls-countdown` attribute to a container element and define a date when the countdown should expire. Just add `date: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssTZD` option to the attribute, using the [ISO 8601 format](https://developer.mozilla.org/en/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date/parse#ECMAScript_5_ISO-8601_format_support), e.g. `2099-12-31T23:59:59Z` (UTC time).

Add the following classes to child elements to apply the necessary functionality.

| Class                   | Description                                                |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.gls-countdown-days`    | Add this class to indicate the days to be counted down.    |
| `.gls-countdown-hours`   | Add this class to indicate the hours to be counted down.   |
| `.gls-countdown-minutes` | Add this class to indicate the minutes to be counted down. |
| `.gls-countdown-seconds` | Add this class to indicate the seconds to be counted down. |
| `.gls-countdown-number`  | Add this class to use it as selector for custom CSS style. |

```html
<div gls-countdown="date: 2099-12-31T23:59:59Z">
    <span class="gls-countdown-number gls-countdown-days"></span>
    <span class="gls-countdown-number gls-countdown-hours"></span>
    <span class="gls-countdown-number gls-countdown-minutes"></span>
    <span class="gls-countdown-number gls-countdown-seconds"></span>
</div>
```

To style the countdown use style classes from the [Base component](https://getuikit.com/docs/base), [Heading component](https://getuikit.com/docs/heading) or [Text component](https://getuikit.com/docs/text).

```html
<div class="gls-h1" gls-countdown="date: 2099-12-31T23:59:59Z"></div>
```

<div class="gls-h1 gls-grid-small gls-child-width-auto gls-flex-middle gls-margin" gls-grid gls-countdown="date: 2099-12-31T23:59:59Z">

## Separator

To insert a separator between each number, use the `.gls-countdown-separator` class.

```html
<div gls-countdown="date: 2099-12-31T23:59:59Z">
    <span class="gls-countdown-number gls-countdown-days"></span>
    <span class="gls-countdown-separator">:</span>
    <span class="gls-countdown-number gls-countdown-hours"></span>
    <span class="gls-countdown-separator">:</span>
    <span class="gls-countdown-number gls-countdown-minutes"></span>
    <span class="gls-countdown-separator">:</span>
    <span class="gls-countdown-number gls-countdown-seconds"></span>
</div>
```

## Label

To add a label to each number, use the `.gls-countdown-label` class.

```html
<div class="gls-countdown-label">Days</div>
<div class="gls-countdown-label">Hours</div>
<div class="gls-countdown-label">Minutes</div>
<div class="gls-countdown-label">Seconds</div>
```

To style the labels use style classes from the [Base component](https://getuikit.com/docs/base), [Heading component](https://getuikit.com/docs/heading) or [Text component](https://getuikit.com/docs/text).

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-grid-small gls-child-width-auto gls-text-center gls-margin" gls-grid gls-countdown="date: 2099-12-31T23:59:59Z">
    <div>
        <div class="gls-h1 gls-countdown-number gls-countdown-days"></div>
        <div class="gls-countdown-label gls-text-small gls-visible@s">Days</div>
    </div>
    <div class="gls-h1"><div class="gls-countdown-separator">:</div></div>
    <div>
        <div class="gls-h1 gls-countdown-number gls-countdown-hours"></div>
        <div class="gls-countdown-label gls-text-small gls-visible@s">Hours</div>
    </div>
    <div class="gls-h1"><div class="gls-countdown-separator">:</div></div>
    <div>
        <div class="gls-h1 gls-countdown-number gls-countdown-minutes"></div>
        <div class="gls-countdown-label gls-text-small gls-visible@s">Minutes</div>
    </div>
    <div class="gls-h1"><div class="gls-countdown-separator">:</div></div>
    <div>

</div>

## Component options

Any of these options can be applied to the component attribute. Separate multiple options with a semicolon. For more information, take a look at the chapter on [component configuration](https://getuikit.com/docs/javascript#component-configuration).

| Option   | Value   | Default | Description                                                                                                                                         |
| -------- | ------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `date`   | String  | `false` | Any string parsable by `Date.parse`. See [Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/en/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date/parse). |
| `reload` | Boolean | `false` | Reload page after countdown expires. Initially expired countdowns won't reload the page.                                                            |

***

## JavaScript

Learn more about [JavaScript components](https://getuikit.com/docs/javascript#programmatic-use).

### Initialization

```js
UIkit.countdown(element, options);
```

### Methods

The following methods are available for the component:

#### Start

```js
UIkit.countdown(element).start();
```

Starts the countdown.

#### Stop

```js
UIkit.countdown(element).stop();
```

Stops the countdown.

***

## Accessibility

The Countdown component automatically sets the appropriate WAI-ARIA roles, states and properties.

- The *container* element has the `timer` role.

<script>
    UIkit.util.attr(UIkit.util.$$('[gls-countdown]'), 'date', new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString());
</script>
